Checkpoint reminders with sound, vibration, and pop-up alerts when allowed by Android
Opening a reminder keeps it visible. Done, Skip, or Snooze clears it. Android may still allow dismissal.
Allow checkpoint names and reminder details on your lock screen. Android privacy settings still apply.
Android controls each style’s sound, vibration, and pop-up alerts. Your system choices take priority.
Enter up to 6 durations in minutes, separated by commas. These shortcuts appear when you tap Snooze on a reminder. Custom is always available.
Enter 1–6 different durations between 1 and 1440 minutes, separated by commas.
